reviewer: Codex root integrator, independent of the group-conversation implementation worker
scope: Explicitly enrolled group conversations across discovery, enrollment, reply policy, per-enrollment workspaces, retained history, summaries and invalidation.
result: Source approved with no unresolved findings; final aggregate and Required CI still required.
checks: Versioned feature negotiation precedes group discovery and polling; omitted flags and direct-chat authority bytes remain unchanged.
The trusted conversation kind governs group policy; a group cannot obtain self-chat privileges and campaigns remain direct-only.
Every group enrollment has a new workspace and canonical local history floor; group history bootstrap is disabled. Snapshot, window, summary, learning and reply paths exclude pre-enrollment messages.
Observed binding change disables the contact, revokes the old grant and marks group bindings invalid permanently. A restored old roster cannot revive its workspace or grant.
Incoming group messages have anonymous participant attribution; prompts and ephemeral summaries never infer that different incoming messages share one speaker.
Both a changed binding and the permanent invalidation marker are checked before a separately reported poll error can be handled as transient. Pending composition and send are cancelled.
Existing capability profiles, native zero-tool XCB execution, explicit account selection, disclosure policy and uncertain-send behavior retain their previous controls.
limits: This review and synthetic tests establish source behavior, not live provider delivery or OS confinement.
Group availability remains conditional on the versioned GhostGet host/provider contract.
